aliases.title: Model Aliases
aliases.intro: Custom alias mappings make your requests simpler. For example, set gpt-4 → high_quality, then requests with model: "gpt-4" are automatically routed to the high-quality model group.
aliases.aliasTip: The name used when a user makes a request
aliases.targetTip: Can be a route group name (e.g. high_quality) or a specific model name
aliases.pleaseEnterTarget: Please enter the target model / route group
